Extraits de documentation pertinents :
### [hyprland-wiki/configuring/core/_index.md] _index
> [!WARNING]
> The default config is not complete and does not include every Hyprland option or feature.
> For every configuration option, see the pages linked from this wiki section.

The config is located in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/hypr/hyprland.lua`.
In most cases, that maps to `~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua`.

You can pass arguments while starting Hyprland (`start-hyprland`), but you must pass your arguments after `--`.
For instance, to use `--config` (or `-c`) to make Hyprland load a non-default config, you might use `start-hyprland -- --config ~/myRices/medium_rare/hyprland.lua`.

If no configuration exists, Hyprland will create an [example config](https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/blob/main/example/hyprland.lua).
Remove `hl.config({ autogenerated = true })` to remove the autogenerated warning banner.

Configuration is reloaded when changes to files are detected.
To reload manually, use `hyprctl reload`.

To get information (class, size, tags, etc.), use:
- `hyprctl clients` to show all windows
- `hyprctl activewindow` to show only the active window

### [hyprland-wiki/getting-started/master-tutorial.md] master-tutorial › In Hyprland with the default config
You're good to go with your adventure, technically.

Use SUPER + Q to launch kitty.
If you wish to choose the default terminal before you proceed, you can do so in `~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua` ([example config](https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/blob/main/example/hyprland.lua)).

If you want the best experience with less hassle googling, keep reading.

### [hyprland-wiki/configuring/core/config-options.md] config-options › Xwayland
Category: `xwayland`

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Limits |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enabled | Allow running applications using X11 | bool | `true` | |
| create_abstract_socket | Create the [abstract Unix domain socket](../../extra/xwayland/#abstract-unix-domain-socket) for Xwayland connections. Xwayland restart is required for changes to take effect; Linux only | bool | `false` | |
| force_zero_scaling | Forces a scale of 1 on Xwayland windows on scaled displays | bool | `false` | |
| use_nearest_neighbor | Uses the nearest neighbor filtering for Xwayland apps, making them pixelated rather than blurry | bool | `true` | |

## Exemples de configs réelles (validées sur ta version) — inspire-toi du style, adapte les valeurs à la demande

### [examples/github/felagund1789__dotfiles/hypr/hyprland.lua] felagund1789__dotfiles/hypr/hyprland.lua
hl.config({
    misc = {
        force_default_wallpaper = -1,    -- Set to 0 or 1 to disable the anime mascot wallpapers
        disable_hyprland_logo   = false, -- If true disables the random hyprland logo / anime girl background. :(
    },
})

---------------
---- INPUT ----
---------------

hl.config({
    input = {
        kb_layout  = "us,gr",
        kb_variant = "",
        kb_model   = "",
        kb_options = "",
        kb_rules   = "",

        numlock_by_default = true,
        follow_mouse = 1,

        sensitivity = 0, -- -1.0 - 1.0, 0 means no modification.

        touchpad = {
            natural_scroll = true,
        },
    },
})

hl.gesture({
    fingers = 3,
    direction = "horizontal",
    action = "workspace"
})

-- Example per-device config
-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Advanced-and-Cool/Devices/ for more
hl.device({
    name        = "epic-mouse-v1",
    sensitivity = -0.5,
})

hl.device({
    name      = "epic-keyboard-v1",
    kb_layout = "us,gr",
})

---------------------
---- KEYBINDINGS ----
---------------------

local mainMod = "SUPER" -- Sets "Windows" key as main modifier

Le dossier de travail est vide. Pour créer une configuration Hyprland complète et moderne (version 0.56+), je vais écrire un fichier `hypr/hyprland.lua` qui inclut :

- Configuration générale (gaps, bordures, arrondis, flou)
- Paramètres d'entrée (clavier, souris, touchpad)
- Bindings pour les applications et la navigation
- Règles de fenêtre personnalisées
- Environnement approprié

Je vais créer une configuration complète et fonctionnelle :

-- Hyprland Configuration v0.56+
-- Fichier principal de configuration Lua

hl.config({
    -- ===== GENERAL CONFIG =====
    misc = {
        force_default_wallpaper = -1,       -- Désactive le wallpaper par défaut
        disable_hyprland_logo   = false,    -- Affiche le logo Hyprland au démarrage
    },
    
    -- ===== INPUT CONFIG =====
    input = {
        kb_layout  = "fr",                  -- Clavier français
        kb_variant = "",
        kb_model   = "",
        kb_options = "",
        kb_rules   = "",
        
        numlock_by_default = true,          -- NumLock activé par défaut
        follow_mouse = 1,                   -- Suivi de la souris (1 = actif)
        
        sensitivity = 0,                    -- Sensibilité du pointeur (0 = normal)
        
        touchpad = {
            natural_scroll = true,          -- Défilement naturel sur le touchpad
        },
    },
    
    -- ===== DECORATION CONFIG =====
    decoration = {
        rounding = 10,                      -- Arrondi des bordures (px)
        blur = {
            enabled = true,                 -- Flou d'arrière-plan activé
            size = 3,                       -- Taille du flou (px)
            passes = 1,                     -- Nombre de passes pour le flou
        },
    },
    
    -- ===== GAP CONFIG =====
    general = {
        gaps_in = 5,                       -- Gap intérieur (px)
        gaps_out = 20,                     -- Gap extérieur (px)
        border_size = 2,                   -- Taille de la bordure (px)
        col = {
            active_border = {              -- Bordure fenêtre active
                colors = {
                    "rgba(33ccffee)",      -- Couleur principale
                    "rgba(00ff99ee)"       -- Couleur secondaire
                },
                angle = 45,                 -- Angle de la bordure (deg)
            },
        },
    },
    
    -- ===== ANIMATION CONFIG =====
    animation = {
        enabled = true,                    -- Animations activées
        bezier = "easeOutQuint",           -- Courbe d'animation
        speed = 4.79,                      -- Vitesse des animations (ms)
        leaf = "windows",                  -- Élément animé : windows
    },
    
    -- ===== CURVE CONFIG =====
    curve = {
        type = "bezier",
        points = {
            {0.23, 1},
            {0.32, 1}
        },
    },
})

-- ===== ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES =====
hl.env("XCURSOR_SIZE", "24")             -- Taille du curseur X11
hl.env("HYPRCURSOR_SIZE", "24")          -- Taille du curseur Hyprland
hl.env("XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP", "Hyprland")
hl.env("XDG_SESSION_TYPE", "wayland")
hl.env("XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP", "Hyprland")
hl.env("XWAYLAND", "1")                  -- Activer XWayland
hl.env("QT_AUTO_SCREEN_SCALE_FACTOR", "1")
hl.env("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "wayland;xcb")
hl.env("QT_WAYLAND_DISABLE_WINDOWDECORATION", "1")

-- ===== GESTURES =====
hl.gesture({
    fingers = 3,
    direction = "horizontal",
    action = "workspace"                   -- Swipe horizontal : changer d'espace de travail
})

-- ===== KEYBINDINGS =====
local mainMod = "SUPER"                   -- Trousse-crayon comme modificateur principal

hl.bind("SUPER + Q", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("kitty"), { locked = true })  -- Terminal Kitty

-- Navigation entre les espaces de travail
hl.bind("SUPER + left", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "left" }))
hl.bind("SUPER + right", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "right" }))
hl.bind("SUPER + up", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "up" }))
hl.bind("SUPER + down", hl.dsp.focus({ direction = "down" }))

-- Navigation entre les fenêtres (clic gauche sur la bordure)
hl.bind("XF86MonBrightnessUp", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("brightnessctl set +5%"))
hl.bind("XF86MonBrightnessDown", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("brightnessctl set 5%-"))
hl.bind("XF86AudioMute", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ toggle"), { locked = true })

-- Gestion des fenêtres
hl.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + mouse:272", hl.dsp.window.drag(), { mouse = true })  -- Glisser-déposer fenêtre
hl.bind("SUPER + F", hl.dsp.window.fullscreen())                               -- Plein écran

-- Fermer la fenêtre active avec Alt+F4
hl.bind("ALT + F4", hl.dsp.window.close(), { locked = true })

-- Raccourcis pour les applications courantes
hl.bind("SUPER + E", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("thunar"))                                -- Gestionnaire de fichiers
hl.bind("SUPER + C", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("code"))                                   -- Éditeur de code
hl.bind("SUPER + N", hl.dsp.exec_cmd("hyprpicker"))                             -- Prendre une capture

-- ===== WINDOW RULES =====
hl.window_rule({
    name = "float-pavu",
    match = { class = "^(pavucontrol)$" },
    float = true,                                                                -- Ouvrir pavucontrol en flottant
})

hl.window_rule({
    name = "no-gaps-browser",
    match = { class = "^(firefox|chromium|google-chrome)$" },
    gaps_in = 0,                                                                 -- Pas de gap pour les navigateurs
    gaps_out = 0,
})

-- ===== LAYER RULES =====
hl.layer_rule({
    name = "blur-waybar",
    match = { namespace = "^waybar$" },
    blur = true,                                                                 -- Flou pour waybar
})

-- ===== WORKSPACE RULES =====
hl.workspace_rule({
    workspace = "w[tv1]",
    gaps_out = 0,                                                               -- Pas de gap pour l'espace TV
    gaps_in = 0,
})

-- ===== HYPRNAGTLAND CONFIG (si disponible) =====
-- hl.nagtl({ enabled = true })

-- ===== STARTUP COMMANDS =====
hl.on("hyprland.start", function()
    -- Lancer waybar au démarrage de Hyprland
    hl.exec_cmd("waybar")
    
    -- Autres commandes de démarrage si nécessaire
end)
